runtime.name: node
runtime.source: bcrypt ^3.0.6 in package.json supports Node.js 12–16 only (bcrypt's compatibility table); Node.js 18+ needs bcrypt >= 6

knownFailures.signature: npm error node-pre-gyp ERR! stack Error: Failed to execute '/usr/local/bin/node /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/node_modules/node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js build --fallback-to-build --module=/workspace/node
knownFailures.cause: bcrypt ^3.0.6 does not build on Node.js 22: bcrypt ^3.0.6 in package.json supports Node.js 12–16 only (bcrypt's compatibility table); Node.js 18+ needs bcrypt >= 6. Node.js 16 is end-of-life, so upgrading bcrypt is the lasting fix.
knownFailures.fix: Node.js 16 (see bcrypt's compatibility table: bcrypt ^3.0.6 supports Node.js 12–16; upgrading to bcrypt >= 6 lets you use a current Node.js)

knownFailures.signature: App starting error: Invalid connection string
knownFailures.cause: MONGODB_URL=YourConnectionString is a placeholder in .env.example, and the app fails on it; HUMBLE sets MONGODB_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/rest-api-nodejs-mongodb (the commented example in .env.example).
knownFailures.fix: `.env.example` now has a working local value for `MONGODB_URL` instead of a placeholder.
